sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Parking rules and roundabouts

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A01
A hydrant needs a six foot clearance, a crosswalk at an intersection twenty feet, a stop sign or signal thirty feet, and a railroad rail fifty feet [A01].
Why it matters: group no-parking distances; difficulty high; prereq sec04-F06; confusables sec04-F06, sec04-F07
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A01
The twenty foot fire station rule applies on the same side of the street, while the seventy-five foot rule applies across the street, and both apply only where signs are posted [A01].
Why it matters: group no-parking distances; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F08; confusables sec04-F08, sec04-F07
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A01
Twelve inches is the curb distance for a parked vehicle, while one hundred fifty feet is the sight distance needed in each direction before parking on a rural highway [A01].
Why it matters: group parking distances; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F02; confusables sec04-F02, sec04-F03
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A02
An emergency vehicle approaching a roundabout means pulling over before entering, but a driver already circulating keeps going and pulls over only after exiting [A02].
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F12; confusables sec04-F15, sec04-F12
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A02
In an unmarked two lane roundabout the right lane is for right turns or through travel and the left lane for left turns or through travel, and once inside no lane change is permitted [A02].
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F13; confusables sec04-F14, sec04-F13
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0031]
